resources.string: All seven model settings are optional. Choose Supply to enter a value; clear Supply to remove that field. Empty supplied text needs correction. Nothing is filled from the catalog, and changing serving mode keeps the other supplied fields.
Temperature

Serving mode

Supply %1$s
Not supplied
temperature: a number from 0 through 2.
top_p: a number greater than 0 and no greater than 1.
max_output_tokens: a whole number of tokens, at least 1. This field does not infer a model capacity limit.
%1$s: choose a literal value or leave it not supplied.
credential_ref: enter an opaque secret:// reference, never a password. This screen does not resolve credentials. Invalid references are excluded from pending-input recovery.
weights_uri: enter a URI without credentials in its authority. Paths, queries and fragments stay literal; this screen does not open the URI.

Recovery retains at most 20,000 characters across these controls (some symbols count as two). Newly captured URI userinfo or an invalid credential reference is replaced by a fixed unavailable notice. The live text stays available for correction until the form closes.
Enter a supplied value, or clear Supply to leave this field absent.
Enter a JSON number using ASCII digits and a decimal point when needed.
Enter a whole JSON number using ASCII digits, without grouping or rounding.
Choose one of the listed literal values or Not supplied.
